answer_1.quote: We leverage open-ended text generation to measure how models manifest political bias by experimenting in the news domain... we establish a news article generation task that demands objectivity and factuality...
answer_1.outputs: generated news articles (headline, article body, quotations)

answer_2.quote: We measured the extent to which models maintain consistent political choices... using two metrics: (i) Prompt Robustness R_P ... (ii) Combination Robustness R_C ... statistical analyses such as χ² tests and Fleiss' κ were also employed.

answer_3.quote: Political bias measurement was performed using the GPT-4o model (2024-08-06 version)... it analyzes the political bias in news headlines, supporter quotations, and overall article narrative orientation, assigning scores according to the criteria above.

answer_4.quote: We then compared scoring results from two human evaluators (H1, H2) and GPT-4o... Evaluators independently assessed three components: headlines, quotations, and narrative orientation, following researcher-provided guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: Researchers provided evaluation guidelines describing how to label headline bias, quotation categories, and overall article orientation.
